answer_1.quote: We frame this task as a generative evaluation task in which a model outputs a ranked list of answers to a given question ...

answer_2.quote: We propose two different metrics, one similar to hits@k ... and one which limits the number of incorrect answers ...

answer_3.quote: We implement a simple version of such vector‑based comparisons ... we train a small classifier ... using RoBERTa ...

answer_4.quote: We collected 30 additional human responses per question ... The human baseline scores are relatively stable ...
answer_4.guideline: Human answers were aggregated by counts to produce a ranked list of responses.
